evals.prompt: Version 1.3.0 delivered for apps/crm/ — consolidate living specs from requirements and completed handoff.
evals.expected_output: Agent uses Version mode, updates or creates domain specs under docs/specs/, updates INDEX.md, changelog entries with version_san per domain.

evals.prompt: Feature 004 added billing endpoints — merge into existing billing.md without deleting old requirements.
evals.expected_output: Agent reads full billing.md, appends/updates requirements and endpoints, records changelog.

evals.prompt: Consolidate specs but Code Review was not Approved for 2.0.0.
evals.expected_output: Agent refuses or defers — Version mode requires Code Review: Approved (no code-review-report.md required).

evals.prompt: Ad-hoc mode from ns-code-coder: Code Review Approved, docs/specs/ exists, task added cancelled_at to connects — update living specs from task + git diff.
evals.expected_output: Agent uses Ad-hoc mode, updates relevant domain spec and INDEX without docs/versions writes, changelog uses adhoc-YYYY-MM-DD, emits consolidation report with Mode: ad-hoc.

evals.prompt: Ad-hoc mode: Approved rename-only refactor, docs/specs/ present.
evals.expected_output: Agent skips writes — non-behavioral diff; reports Living specs skipped.
